Creates a Tenable Vulnerability Management cloud connector.
Note: For AWS cloud connectors, you can get the available AWS cloudtrails for your account via the
POST /settings/connectors/aws/cloudtrails endpoint.
Note: Frictionless Assessment has reached the End-of-Provisioning phase of its product lifecycle.
For more information, see Frictionless Assessment End-of-Provisioning.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
One of
Amazon Web Services (Keyed)
Amazon Web Services (Keyless)
Amazon Web Services with Frictionless Assessment
Microsoft Azure
Microsoft Azure with Frictionless Assessment
Google Cloud Platform (Keyed)
Google Cloud Platform Workload Identity Federation
object
